data.long_meaning: The name Aubin originates from the Greek word 'au' meaning 'love' and 'baino' meaning 'to go'. The name Aubin symbolizes a friend who goes above and beyond to show love and support. The name Aubin carries the meaning “Friend, love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aubin usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aubin may be of French origin, but it has gained popularity across various Christian communities worldwide. The name Aubin is known to represent a companion who is always there, offering unwavering support and encouragement amidst life's challenges.
